GTA 6 Ultimate vs Standard: Ultimate won #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said more people pre-ordered GTA 6's $99.99 Ultimate Edition than the $79.99 standard one: "the most avid consumers are the ones who are pre-ordering now." The extra $20 opens five businesses in Vice City that only run with the Ultimate Edition (Rockstar's edition page). Our take: for an 80-hour game, $20 is cheap. Which one did you get?

Sources: TechRadar, Dexerto, MP1st (Zelnick); Rockstar Games (Ultimate Edition page); Tom's Guide, Shacknews (prices).
